verdict.waiting: Waiting for the first data from sing-box
verdict.waitingHint: The daemon stream has just opened: the numbers will appear in a couple of seconds.
verdict.offlineHint: The numbers below are not updating. The panel reconnects on its own; if it does not, check that the router is reachable over the network.
verdict.silentHint: The daemon responds, but no data comes from sing-box: the numbers below are frozen. Look for the cause in the log.
verdict.stoppedHint: No traffic goes through sing-box. Start it from the sing-box card below; the reason it stopped is in the log.
verdict.nodeDown: The selected node does not respond
verdict.nodeDownHint: Traffic through this node does not get through. Pick another node or test the latency again.
verdict.hotHint: From {{limit}} °C the board lowers its clock. Check the cooling and the load in the Router section below.
verdict.warmHint: There is headroom before {{limit}} °C, where the board lowers its clock. The temperature is in the Router section below.
verdict.okHint: sing-box is running, data is flowing, the selected nodes are not failing.
